name: Italian Pan-Fried Chicken Cutlets with Parmesan-Bread Crumb Coating (Batch-Cooking)

instructions.primary_message: Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Transfer to a large parchment paper-lined baking sheet pan, then season both sides with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
8 medium chicken breasts, boneless skinless
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place flour, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl, then whisk to combine. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup all-purpose flour
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place eggs and water in another medium bowl, then whisk until smooth. Set aside.
Place bread crumbs, Parmesan, and spices in a third medium bowl, then whisk to combine. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 cups panko bread crumbs
½ cup Parmesan cheese, grated
2 tsp Italian seasoning
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
1 tsp oregano, dried
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Working one by one, coat the cutlets in flour, shaking off any excess. Dip in the beaten egg (letting the excess drip off), then into the bread crumb mixture, pressing gently to adhere. Return breaded cutlets to the baking sheet.

Place oil in a large skillet and heat over medium-high. (The skillet should have about 1/2-inch of oil.) Once the oil is hot (a bread crumb should sizzle when dropped in), working in batches, add cutlets and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, about 3 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean paper towel-lined baking sheet.
To serve, transfer cutlets to a serving platter and enjoy!
